_about: Click-through demos for the Core repair order agent (Repair order mode, Demo menu). Each step is typed the way an advisor types: short, shorthand, misspelled, so the model has to decode it. Steps that do not start with a correctly spelled 'add' go to the model; 'total?' is answered by the deterministic rules. laborRate is used for the session only when the shop has not set one. starters are one-click openers shown on a new repair order: one message each, typed like an advisor, to show what the agent decodes and checks in a single turn.

scenarios.title: CV axle: typos to a priced job, both sides cheaper
scenarios.intro: Demo: an advisor's shorthand with typos and a VIN. Watch the agent decode it, match the OEM schedule from the VIN, offer add-on labor with a customer line, and price both sides as one job.

scenarios.title: A/C: two parts replaced, one recharge billed
scenarios.intro: Demo: a compressor and a condenser on the same car. Each needs the A/C evacuated and recharged, but the system is only recharged once, so only one is billed.

scenarios.title: Water pump: the thermostat for a fraction of the labor
scenarios.intro: Demo: the advisor throws in a thermostat with a water pump. The labor guide prices it as add-on labor, not a second job, and the agent explains it to the customer.

scenarios.intro: Demo: a rear valve cover leak on a V6 means the intake comes off. Spark plugs added now are add-on labor instead of a separate job.
